identity.name: Velodyne
identity.tagline: Forged in Speed. Defined by Excellence.
identity.one_line_description: Velodyne is the official website of an elite professional cycling race team, showcasing its athletes, performance data, editorial stories, and team culture.
identity.target_audience: Cycling enthusiasts, sports media, sponsors, and aspiring professional cyclists who follow elite road racing at the national and international level.

pages.title: Home
pages.goal: Establish Velodyne as a world-class cycling race team, communicate the team's identity and ambition, and direct visitors toward athletes, performance, and stories.
pages.meta_description: Velodyne is an elite professional cycling race team built on precision, endurance, and the relentless pursuit of victory. Meet the team and follow the journey.

sections.intent: Make an immediate, powerful first impression that communicates the team's elite status and competitive spirit.
sections.headline: Forged in Speed. Defined by Excellence.
sections.subheadline: Velodyne competes at the highest level of road cycling — from Grand Tours to one-day classics — driven by precision training, elite athletes, and an uncompromising pursuit of the podium.

sections.intent: Highlight the three defining pillars of the Velodyne team to orient new visitors and reinforce brand credibility.
sections.headline: Three Pillars of a Winning Team

items.title: Elite Roster
items.description: A squad of world-ranked climbers, sprinters, and all-rounders selected for their exceptional talent and competitive record.

items.title: Data-Driven Performance
items.description: Every watt, every kilometer, every recovery metric is analyzed to give our riders the competitive edge on race day.

items.title: A Legacy of Victories
items.description: From Grand Tour stage wins to monument podiums, Velodyne's palmares speaks for itself across the world's most prestigious races.

sections.intent: Convert engaged visitors into followers or sponsor inquiries by offering a clear next step.
sections.headline: Ride With Velodyne
sections.subheadline: Whether you're a fan, a journalist, or a potential partner — we want to hear from you.

pages.title: Athletes
pages.goal: Introduce each member of the Velodyne roster with depth and character, building emotional connection and credibility with fans, sponsors, and media.
pages.meta_description: Meet the Velodyne cycling team roster — a world-class lineup of climbers, sprinters, and classics specialists competing at the pinnacle of professional road racing.

sections.intent: Set the tone for the roster page and frame the athletes as the heart of the team's identity.
sections.headline: The Athletes Behind the Jersey
sections.subheadline: Every rider on the Velodyne squad brings a unique discipline, story, and drive. Together, they form one of the most formidable lineups in professional cycling.

sections.intent: Display the full team roster in a card-based format that communicates each rider's specialty, nationality, and key achievements.
sections.headline: Meet the Team

items.title: Marco Ferretti
items.description: General Classification | Italy | 3× Grand Tour stage winner, 2024 Vuelta top-5 finisher.

items.title: Lena Brandt
items.description: Climber | Germany | Queen of the Mountains winner, renowned for her explosive alpine attacks.

items.title: Théo Marchais
items.description: Sprinter | France | 12 professional sprint victories, Paris–Nice stage winner.

items.title: Cian O'Sullivan
items.description: Classics Specialist | Ireland | Top-10 at Paris–Roubaix and Tour of Flanders in back-to-back seasons.

items.title: Yuki Tanaka
items.description: Domestique & Time Trialist | Japan | Elite support rider and national TT champion.

items.title: Rafael Dos Santos
items.description: Puncheur | Brazil | Known for his explosive finishing on punchy climbs and cobbled finales.

sections.intent: Direct visitors from the athlete profiles toward the team's performance data or contact page for sponsorship inquiries.
sections.headline: See What Our Riders Are Capable Of
sections.subheadline: Explore the data and metrics that power Velodyne's race strategy.

pages.title: Performance
pages.goal: Demonstrate the team's scientific approach to training and racing, building credibility with sponsors, media, and performance-minded fans.
pages.meta_description: Discover how Velodyne uses cutting-edge sports science, data analytics, and precision training to prepare its riders for the world's toughest races.

sections.intent: Frame the performance page as a window into the team's competitive methodology and scientific rigor.
sections.headline: The Architecture of a Winning Season
sections.subheadline: Behind every podium finish is a system — built on data, endurance science, and relentless preparation. This is how Velodyne trains to win.

sections.intent: Use key performance figures to communicate the scale and seriousness of the team's competitive output.
sections.headline: Results That Speak for Themselves

items.description: Race victories across UCI World Tour and ProSeries events.

sections.intent: Break down the team's performance philosophy into distinct, digestible disciplines that showcase the breadth of their approach.
sections.headline: How We Build Champions

items.title: Power Profiling
items.description: Every rider undergoes detailed VO2 max and functional threshold power testing to build individualized training zones.

items.title: Race Intelligence
items.description: Our analytics team studies course profiles, weather patterns, and rival team tactics to craft race-day strategy.

items.title: Altitude Camps
items.description: Pre-season and mid-season altitude blocks at Sierra Nevada and Livigno drive the aerobic adaptations that matter most.

pages.title: Stories
pages.goal: Engage fans, media, and sponsors with long-form editorial content including race reports, rider profiles, behind-the-scenes features, and team announcements.
pages.meta_description: Follow the Velodyne cycling team through race dispatches, rider features, training diaries, and season highlights — all told in the team's own voice.

sections.intent: Set an editorial, magazine-like tone that invites readers to explore the team's narrative across the season.
sections.headline: Stories From the Road
sections.subheadline: Race dispatches, rider profiles, training diaries, and the moments that define a season. This is Velodyne — unfiltered.

sections.intent: Surface the latest and most compelling editorial content in a card-grid format that encourages browsing and reading.
sections.headline: What We've Been Writing

items.title: Stage 17: How Ferretti Took the Maglia Rosa
items.description: A minute-by-minute account of the most dramatic stage of the Giro d'Italia and the tactical brilliance that put our GC leader in pink.

items.title: Lena Brandt: The Climb That Changed Everything
items.description: A long-form profile on the German climber's journey from junior national champion to Grand Tour queen of the mountains.

items.title: Inside the Altitude Camp: 21 Days at Livigno
items.description: Our sports science team documents the brutal and beautiful process of building race fitness at 1,800 meters above sea level.

items.title: The Classics Campaign: Cobbles, Crashes, and Character
items.description: Cian O'Sullivan reflects on the spring classics campaign — the preparation, the pain, and what it means to race Paris–Roubaix.

sections.intent: Encourage readers to stay connected with the team or explore sponsorship opportunities after engaging with editorial content.
sections.headline: Never Miss a Dispatch
sections.subheadline: Follow the season as it unfolds — race by race, rider by rider.

pages.title: Contact
pages.goal: Provide a clear, premium-feeling contact experience for sponsors, media professionals, aspiring riders, and fans who want to connect with the Velodyne team.
pages.meta_description: Get in touch with the Velodyne cycling team for sponsorship inquiries, media accreditation, rider recruitment, or general fan correspondence.

sections.intent: Set a welcoming but professional tone that signals the team is open to meaningful conversations.
sections.headline: Let's Talk
sections.subheadline: Whether you're a sponsor, journalist, or a rider who wants to race for Velodyne — we'd love to hear from you.

sections.intent: Clarify the different types of inquiries the team receives so visitors can self-select and feel their message will reach the right person.
sections.eyebrow: Who Are You Reaching Out To?
sections.headline: We're Ready for Your Message

items.title: Sponsorship & Partnerships
items.description: Interested in aligning your brand with one of cycling's most exciting teams? Our commercial team is ready to explore what's possible.

items.title: Media & Press
items.description: For race accreditation, interview requests, press kits, and photography access, contact our communications team directly.

items.title: Rider Recruitment
items.description: Are you a competitive cyclist looking to race at the highest level? Send your palmares and power data to our performance director.

sections.intent: Provide a direct contact form and essential team contact details for visitors ready to reach out.
